#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BASE=/export/home/yinjinrun/.borrow/chenjunyu/xllm-h800
DIR="$BASE/inputs/aiperf"
EXP="$BASE/experiments/aiperf"
RUNNER="$DIR/aiperf_h800_v4_2_native.py"
REPO="$BASE/xllm_quant_kvcache-native-fp8-admission-ceff00bb"
BIN="$REPO/build/h800-native-fp8-admission/bin/xllm"
SHA=ceff00bbd38054d2b6b4aa44513d773f2bd174b2

run_pair() {
    local isl="$1" osl="$2" label="$3" cs="$4" out="$5"
    local src="$DIR/v3_canonical_v32/isl${isl}_osl${osl}_n136_seed20261020/canonical_inputs.json"
    local -a cc
    read -r -a cc <<< "$cs"

    test -f "$src"
    test ! -e "$out"

    local -a cmd=(
        python3 "$RUNNER" run
        --kind inputs_json
        --source "$src"
        --repo "$REPO"
        --server-binary "$BIN"
        --expected-commit "$SHA"
        --group 14b-native
        --arms bf16 fp8_e4m3
        --gpus 2
        --concurrency "${cc[@]}"
        --requests 128 --warmup 8
        --fp8-k-scale 0.125
        --fp8-v-scale 0.0625
        --graph-mode cudagraphs
        --out "$out"
    )

    echo "========== START $label =========="
    "${cmd[@]}" --check-only > /dev/null
    "${cmd[@]}"
    test -f "$out/COMPLETE"
    echo "========== PASS $label =========="
}

FIRST="$EXP/native_flashinfer_14b_16k512_C4_graph_ceff00bb_g2_001"

# 对接此前的第一组实验，不重复启动
if [ -f "$FIRST/COMPLETE" ]; then
    echo "First experiment already complete"
elif [ -e "$FIRST" ]; then
    echo "Waiting for existing 16K/C4 tmux experiment"
    while [ ! -f "$FIRST/COMPLETE" ]; do
        if ! tmux has-session -t cjyu-v42-ceff-g2 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "First experiment incomplete and original tmux exited"
            exit 1
        fi
        sleep 30
    done
else
    run_pair 16384 512 "16k-C4" "4" "$FIRST"
fi

run_pair 8192 512 "8k-C4-C8" "4 8" \
    "$EXP/native_ceff00bb_8k512_C4_C8_g2_001"

run_pair 16384 512 "16k-C8" "8" \
    "$EXP/native_ceff00bb_16k512_C8_g2_001"

run_pair 24576 512 "24k-C2-C4" "2 4" \
    "$EXP/native_ceff00bb_24k512_C2_C4_g2_001"

run_pair 8192 1024 "8k1024-C4-C8" "4 8" \
    "$EXP/native_ceff00bb_8k1024_C4_C8_g2_001"

run_pair 8192 512 "8k-C16" "16" \
    "$EXP/native_ceff00bb_8k512_C16_g2_001"

echo "========== ALL OVERNIGHT EXPERIMENTS COMPLETE =========="
